expectations.text: Flags that service.ts performs database access directly (imports db/client and db/schema, builds Drizzle queries) instead of delegating to the repository
expectations.evidence: Critical finding 1: names the db singleton import, the Drizzle table + operators, and the direct db.select/db.insert calls; notes an existing NotificationsRepository is ignored.

expectations.text: Flags that NotificationsService takes `Container` as a constructor parameter instead of the specific ports it needs
expectations.evidence: Major finding 4: 'Service depends on the whole Container (service-locator anti-pattern)'; recommends injecting NotificationsRepository and a GithubPort.

expectations.text: Flags that routes.ts imports and calls NotificationsRepository directly, bypassing the service layer
expectations.evidence: Critical finding 2: 'Route calls the repository directly and holds domain logic'; recommends a service.markRead and deleting the repository import from routes.ts.

expectations.text: Does not invent violations that are not present (no more than one clearly-wrong extra finding)
expectations.evidence: Extras (row type crossing, github not behind injected port, wiring in route file, isNull cast bug, dead code) are all real; none clearly wrong.

expectations.text: For each real finding, names the correct fix (move persistence into the repository; inject ports; route through the service)
expectations.evidence: Each finding has a Fix line: inject repository, move query into repo method; add service.markRead throwing NotFoundError; inject explicit collaborators.

notes: Baseline already catches all three planted violations plus valid extras; more verbose (8 findings) and less tied to named repo rules, but correct. Also caught a real latent bug (eq(col, null)).
